parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

> - The end time must be later than the start time.
>
> - You can query data within the last four days.
>
> - The maximum time interval between **StartTime** and **EndTime** is three hours.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Redis instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: The ID of the data shard of the Redis instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
